speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me determine the cause, could you please describe how long you have been feeling this way and if the symptoms have been constant or fluctuating?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned difficulty with self-care after hiking; are you currently experiencing muscle aches, dark urine, or swelling in your legs? Additionally, could you specify which "multiple illnesses" you had recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of fatigue, weakness, and mild diplopia (double vision) is highly characteristic of this autoimmune neuromuscular disorder. I am requesting a diagnostic test to confirm this.

REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibody (AChR-Ab) and MuSK_antibody.
REQUEST TEST: Chest_CT.
